title: fix(app-shell): a landed Studio draft autosave names what it saved
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbFPK3cqnvvFAN4urKaJe8sv)_

Fixes #28984

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The two lines are copied from the claim (comment 6574193432).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 里草稿自动保存落地后，现在弹出一条点名的提示「Draft saved: 对象/页面/流程名」（中文界面为「已保存 X 的草稿」），覆盖 Data（对象及其定制扩展）、Interfaces（页面、仪表板、报表、应用导航）和 Automations（流程）三个支柱；顶栏的「Saved 时:分」保留不动。
- 为什么改：#28345 裁决 ② 定了顶栏「已保存」不算写入反馈，只有点名条目的反馈才算；此前自动保存落地后界面上没有任何点名，`ux-conventions.write-feedback` 的 Studio 自动保存一行一直判红。
- 风险与回滚：每个条目只用一个固定的提示 id，连续输入多次保存只会原地更新同一条提示，不会堆叠；保存被拒时仍走原有的拒绝条，不会说「已保存」。新增一个 studio 命名空间文案键，不改任何元数据或接口。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 里新增的 `announceDraftSaved` 及其五处调用（只在保存成功之后调用）；新测试 `DataPillar.draftSavedNamed-28984.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/DataPillar.draftSavedNamed-28984.test.tsx`，预期 3 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: one module helper, `announceDraftSaved`, shows `toast.success("Draft saved: LABEL", { id })` with one sonner id per item (`studio-draft-saved:TYPE:NAME`). It is called in the five draft autosave saves of this file, right after the save has landed and before `onDraftSaved`:
  - Data pillar, the object save: named by the label the save stored (an edit of the object's own label names the new label), else the rail's label.
  - Data pillar, an object extension save (a package that customizes a base object): named by the open object's label.
  - Interfaces pillar, a leaf save (page, dashboard, report, and the other leaf types): named as the rail names the leaf.
  - Interfaces pillar, the app navigation save: named by the app's label.
  - Automations pillar, the flow save: named as the rail names the flow.
- The old comment "No success toast: … the quiet last-saved hint is the affordance" is replaced: ruling 6545938831 ② on #28345 says that hint is not write feedback.
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts` and `zh.ts`: one new key, `engine.studio.draftSaved`, "Draft saved: {item}" / 「已保存 {item} 的草稿」, in the voice of the discard row's `engine.edit.draftDiscarded` ("Draft discarded: {item}").
- Root changeset `.changeset/28984-studio-draft-saved-named.md`, `patch` for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

## Why

- **A toast, not inline status text,** because Studio's other write rows are toasts: publish ("Published 1 item in this package"), discard ("Draft discarded: QA Widget"), the app and automation create rows (`engine.studio.app.savedDraft`, `engine.studio.auto.savedDraft`). One Studio voice. Sonner's toaster is an `aria-live` region, so the sentence is announced.
- **One id per item, not one per save,** because the autosave fires 1.5 s after every editing pause. Sonner updates a toast that already carries the id instead of stacking a new one (the pattern `PACKAGE_LIST_TOAST_ID` already uses in this file). Typing a label gives one live toast; a second item saved meanwhile gets its own.
- **Called only after the save has landed.** A refused or failed save keeps today's path (the refusal strip) and says nothing about saving; a conflict the author settled by reloading the saved version (`outcome === 'reloaded'`) saved nothing and announces nothing.
- The top bar's "Saved HH:MM", the Draft chip and the Changes counter are unchanged. Nothing is removed.
- `StudioRefusalStrip` (changed by #29224, now on main) is not touched; the five call sites and the helper are hunk-disjoint from it.

## Tests

- New `DataPillar.draftSavedNamed-28984.test.tsx`: the Data pillar's real autosave, a real `MetadataClient` over a fetch double, and sonner's real `Toaster` mounted, so the assertions read the toasts on screen.
  - a landed save shows one toast "Draft saved: Task" (called with `{ id: 'studio-draft-saved:object:showcase_task' }`), and the top bar's `data-saved-at` hint is there;
  - a refused save (422) shows `studio-refusal`, no draft-saved toast and no call under that id;
  - Add field, then the field's label typed in its inspector (the card's own edit): at least two landed saves, two announcements, one toast on screen, every announcement under the one id. The toaster's duration is 60 s here, so the first toast is still up when the second save lands.
- Ablation, two legs, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed fix (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed, restore proven equal to HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`):
  - the object save's `announceDraftSaved(` call replaced by a no-op function call: the landed and the repeated cases went red (`expected [] to have a length of 1 but got +0`), the refused case stayed green. A first attempt (`void (…)`) did not parse, so no test ran; it is not counted.
  - the toast id given a per-save random suffix: the repeated case went red at the on-screen count (`one toast, updated in place, not a pile: expected [ …(2) ] to have a length of 1 but got 2`), and the landed case at the id.
- Related files: every app-shell test file naming `StudioDesignSurface`, `DataPillar`, `InterfacesPillar` or `AutomationsPillar` (221), plus the studio namespace tests in `@object-ui/i18n` and the studio catalogue pins in metadata-admin (`zh-base-term.i18n-13131`, `studioAutomationCopy.plainLanguage-11659`, `inspectorStrings.studioNamespace-25922`): 226 files, 1887 tests, green in five locked batches at c5511bd1; after merging main, the same selection (230 files, 1910 tests, the new test included) green again at f9f3982b.

## Acceptance notes

- **Same file, in order.** #29224 (the refusal strip's `role="alert"`) landed first as 8a8a03d3 and is merged in; this PR does not touch `StudioRefusalStrip`. Seat 5's #29113 and #29148 edit `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` after this one and take it as their serial constraint.
- **The toast names the object, not the field.** The ruling accepts either. The pillar's save sends the whole object, and the edit that triggered it is not tracked per field, so the object's label is the item the save wrote.
- `engine.studio.data.savedDraft` ("Object “{label}” saved as draft") is an existing key with no call site. It is not reused here: its "saved as draft" wording is the create rows' voice, and one key for every autosave keeps the five pillars in one voice with discard.

## Out of scope

Two observations, not measured as defects and not filed. They are listed for the next card on these editors.

- **Draft saves in five editors outside this card's file surface still name nothing (not measured live).** `useObjectListViewDraft` (an Interfaces list-view leaf), `ObjectHooksPanel`, `PermissionMatrixEditor` and `StudioBundleItemEditor` run the same draft autosave, and the Data pillar's column drag-reorder (`doReorderFields`) saves a draft directly. None of them calls `announceDraftSaved`.
- **The toast sits over the top bar's Draft chip and "Saved" hint while it shows.** The Console's toaster is anchored top-centre (its own pin, `ConsoleToaster.autoDismiss-7482`). At 1440 px the toast covers the header's Draft chip and saved hint for its 4 s. Publish and discard toasts already show in the same place, so this placement is shared and is not specific to this card.

## Verification

- **Live, the card's reproduction, before and after** (head c5511bd1, full `pnpm build` 12m31s locked): `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` for the showcase on a private port, the Console served from source by Vite with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`, signed in as the seeded admin. As in the card: `POST /api/v1/packages` (`com.qa.r6wf`, namespace `qrsix`), then `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/OBJECT?package=com.qa.r6wf` with label "QA Widget", `sharingModel: "private"` and text fields `name` and `note`. Studio › Data › the object › Form › "Note" › Label cleared and typed "QA Remark" in three bursts with editing pauses, then Tab, sampled every 100 ms to 6 s after the last keystroke.
  - This branch: three `PUT …?mode=draft&package=com.qa.r6wf&surface=studio`, all 200. At most one toast on screen at any sample, its text "Draft saved: QA Widget" throughout; the top bar still read "Saved 10:18 AM".
  - origin/main's `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (swapped in under a restarted `vite --force`, the served module checked to carry no `announceDraftSaved` against a positive control on the restored file, then restored, blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty): the same three PUTs, all 200; zero toasts over the window, no status or alert text; only the top bar's "Saved 10:20 AM".
- **Built types (Clause-②):** `ui/packages/i18n/dist/namespaces/studio/en.d.ts` declares `STUDIO_EN` as a `Record` from string to string after the build; the new key is in `en.js` and in no `.d.ts`. It widens no published type.
- **Gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 34 commands; all 34 ran at c5511bd1 and again at f9f3982b (after merging main; the same 34 derived), each exit 0, including `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and its `--self-test`, `pnpm check:type-check-debt` (locked) and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (locked, 169 files, 4900 tests). `--ran` reconciliation at f9f3982b: 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- **Type-check:** `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/i18n`, 66 tasks green at c5511bd1 and at f9f3982b.
- **Head f9f3982b** merges origin/main at 8a8a03d3 (with #29224) into the fix; the merge was clean, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `pnpm build` (13m20s locked) were rerun before the re-runs above, and the delta to main is the five files of this PR. The live probe ran at c5511bd1; the merge touched `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` only in the refusal strip, which the probe's landed saves never draw.
- **Lint:** eslint on the four touched ui files, 0 errors; its 43 warnings are all on existing lines of `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, none on a changed line. The repo-wide run is CI's Lint UI.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (Not touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (Measured on the touched files only; see Verification.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
